description: This file defines a React component for a Marketplace page in a career development application. It displays various opportunity recommendations, skill gap resources, and roadmap-related content, using placeholder data. The page emphasizes a read-only, recommendation-focused view without any 'Add to Roadmap' actions.

methods.name: safeParseRoadmapState
methods.description: Parses string input from localStorage into a RoadmapState object with validation and error handling.

methods.name: clamp
methods.description: Ensures a number falls within a specified range.

methods.name: completionSummary
methods.description: Calculates summary counts of milestones based on their statuses.

methods.name: countSkillGapsFromDeltas
methods.description: Heuristically counts completed, in-progress, and missing skills based on delta data.

methods.name: usePrefersReducedMotion
methods.description: Custom React hook that detects user preference for reduced motion.

methods.name: BadgePill
methods.description: A styled badge component with color variants.

methods.name: MetricCard
methods.description: Displays a metric (completed, in-progress, missing skills) in a styled card.

methods.name: OpportunityCard
methods.description: Displays opportunity details, including type icon, title, provider, rating, skills, and optional milestone/skill gap info.

methods.name: MarketplaceJourneyPage
methods.description: Main React component rendering the entire Marketplace page with sections for career context, recommendations, skill gaps, explore, and personalized suggestions; uses staggered animations and local storage data.
